protocol.title: Cross-sectional put-call skew basis (BTC-vs-ETH relative skew) -> subsequent relative *variance risk premium* (VRP) spread (BTC-minus-ETH forward atm_iv - forward_RV): wrapper-free Spearman rank information coefficient (predictiveness) falsification on the real on-disk three-way captures
protocol.extends: EVAL-77 (same cross-sectional BTC-vs-ETH surface basis and aligned common-bar reconstruction, reused verbatim; skew basis) and EVAL-86 (forward VRP definition atm_iv - forward_RV, reused verbatim) but a DISTINCT target: the forward relative VRP *spread* (BTC minus ETH), not the relative RV spread (EVAL-77), not the relative return direction (EVAL-88), not own-asset VRP (EVAL-86); no new acquisition
protocol.supersedes: nothing — this is the relative-value *VRP* complement to EVAL-86 (own-asset skew -> own VRP) and a distinct cell from EVAL-77 (relative-vol spread) and EVAL-88 (relative direction). It makes a predictiveness claim only, no traded-form / monetization claim

cross_section.target: y_k = VRP_BTC(k) - VRP_ETH(k) with VRP_i(k) = atm_iv_i(k) - forward_RV_i(k+1..k+H) (forward relative variance risk premium spread)

protocol.signal: causal per-bar put-call skew surface (EVAL-71 build_surface_bars) for BTC and ETH: skew = mean(put iv) - mean(call iv) over near-ATM trades; the relative series (ETH - BTC) is forward-filled then expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e61.expanding_zscore via EVAL-77). The skew basis is used (not atm_iv) so the signal does not mechanically appear inside the target.
protocol.target_detail: forward relative VRP = per underlying VRP = atm_iv at bar k minus forward realized vol sqrt(mean(log-return^2)) over the next H perp bars (strictly after the decision at bar k, EVAL-71 _forward_rv via EVAL-77 _rv_series), then BTC minus ETH on the common aligned bar grid
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(rel_z_k, y_k) over the common aligned bar-ends (H1: IC > 0, ETH skew-richness predicts BTC carries the richer forward VRP — relative-value VRP mean reversion)

stats.permutation: directional (H1: IC>0), shuffle the relative-VRP spread

protocol.go_bar: GO only if at least one config (skew basis x bar grid x horizon) has Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, at least min_usable_pairs_per_config usable pairs, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).
